A little bit more about myself...

I graduated in 2025 with a degree in Communication, Culture, Information & Technology, where my interest in digital engagement, brand storytelling, and audience-centered communication first began to take shape. What started in the classroom quickly evolved into hands-on experience in developing campaigns, shaping messaging, and bringing ideas to life across both digital and in-person spaces. Through my involvement in campus organizations and part-time roles, I became deeply engaged in partnership development, external relations, event coordination, and cross-functional collaboration.

In high school, I was an artistic student, naturally drawn to visual thinking, creative expression, and noticing details others often overlooked. That creative instinct continues to guide how I approach communication today, shaping work that is intentional, thoughtful, and always focused on connection.

Outside of the academic and professional world, I’m drawn to travel as a way of slowing down and taking in new perspectives, especially places with landscapes that make you pause and really feel present. Some of my favourite destinations so far include Turkey, Italy, and Egypt. At home, I enjoy experimenting with coffee flavours and creating my own blends, and I often find myself working on creative projects that bring ideas to life, whether for friends or for my own space.
